gdp_level.label: GDP nominal, current prices, SCA (Eurostat namq_10_gdp, CP_MEUR)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, chain-linked volume, SCA (Eurostat namq_10_gdp, CLV20_MEUR)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, QoQ, SCA (derived from Eurostat namq_10_gdp, CLV20_MEUR)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, total (Eurostat, world partner, derived EXP-IMP)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (Eurostat)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (Eurostat)

business_confidence.label: Business confidence indicator, LT avg = 100 (OECD BCICP)

population.label: Population, total, mid-year estimate, annual (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL)

gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per person, current prices, calendar year (GDP divided by World Bank population)
